entry.title: Anderson Permeability — When Institutions Lose Their Membranes
entry.content:
Lens: 🕸️ Topology ⚛️ Lattice 📅 Chronology 💰 Money ⚖️ Legal 🏛️ Capture

From Localization to Permeability

The Anderson Localization analysis showed how disorder in the judicial lattice traps cases — like electrons in a disordered crystal, cases entering captured courts cannot propagate to fair hearings.

This page documents a second phenomenon from the same physics: Anderson permeability — when the membranes between institutions dissolve entirely.

In condensed matter physics, a membrane’s permeability determines what passes through it. A healthy cell membrane is selectively permeable: nutrients in, waste out, toxins blocked. When the membrane fails — when everything passes through — the cell dies.

Institutions have membranes too:

MembraneWhat It Should BlockWhat It Should Allow
CredentialUnqualified staffCredentialed educators
AuthorizationAuthorizer staff at authorized schoolIndependent oversight
GovernanceConflicts of interestIndependent board members
DynastyFamily concentration in one enterpriseMerit-based hiring
EnforcementContinued operation after findingsInvestigation → correction
TransparencyHidden staff, unlisted employeesPublic accountability

This page measures each membrane.

Membrane 1: Credential 📄 Documented

The credential membrane should block unqualified individuals from teaching children or managing schools. It is maintained by MOECS (Michigan Online Educator Certification System) and MCL 388.1763.

Measurement

Staff MemberRoleCredential StatusMembrane Status

Chalcee NorwoodDean of Ops + 8th GradeTourism degree. Zero MOECS results. Event planning LLC.Breached
Cameron ColemanDean of ScholarsStandard cert expired 6/30/2026. No admin cert.Breached

Rachel WebbKindergartenHolds Secondary English 6-12 cert. Teaching kindergarten.Breached
Jason PerryPCA StaffNot in any database. Convergence score = 0.Unknown

Credential membrane status: BREACHED. See: Full credential audit

Membrane 2: Authorization 📄 Documented

The authorization membrane should separate the authorizer (DPSCD) from the authorized (Banks’ schools). This boundary ensures independent oversight — the people granting the charter are not the people running the school.

Measurement

Three staff members simultaneously serve DPSCD (authorizer) and Banks (authorized):

Cameron ColemanDean of Culture (since 2021)MacDowell Dean of ScholarsConcurrent
Dr. Chalena BeasleyPrincipal, Bunche Prep (29 years)PCA School LeaderSequential (retired → recruited)

Authorization membrane status: DISSOLVED. The authorizer’s own employees run the authorized school. The oversight boundary does not exist.

Membrane 3: Governance 📄 Documented

The governance membrane should prevent conflicts of interest on school boards. Board members should be independent of the enterprise they oversee.

Measurement (PCA Board)

Board MemberOther RoleConflict

Measurement (MacDowell Board)

Nicole Wells-StallworthBoard President (since 2014)Stallworth dynasty — married Thomas Stallworth III

Governance membrane status: CAPTURED. Two sitting judges. One AAG. One city council member. One Crump.

Membrane 4: Dynasty 📄 Documented

The dynasty membrane should prevent family concentration in one enterprise. Merit-based hiring requires that hiring decisions are not driven by surname.

Measurement: Three Dynasties

Stallworth Dynasty (confirmed):

    → Nicole Wells-Stallworth (MacDowell Board President since 2014)

Membranes penetrated: Legislature, school board, authorizer board, nonprofit.

Banks Dynasty (confirmed):

  → Brian Banks (9 convictions → enterprise leader)
    → Carol Banks (Original Eastside Slate → political endorsements, FBI target)

Dynasty membrane status: THREE DYNASTY WAVES. The Crump dynasty — if the family connection is confirmed — has the highest permeability of any dynasty in the graph: five or more membranes penetrated by three surname-linked individuals.

Membrane 5: Enforcement 📄 Documented

The enforcement membrane should prevent continued operation after regulatory findings. When an institution finds a problem, it should produce a correction.

The transparency membrane should ensure public accountability — staff are listed, meetings are open, records are available.

Transparency membrane status: OPAQUE (PCA). PCA has no staff page. Two staff members have convergence score = 0 — they exist inside the institution but are invisible to every public database.

The Permeability Map

BANKS ENTERPRISE — ALL MEMBRANES
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

 CREDENTIAL     ████████░░  BREACHED
                Fake J.D. Tourism degree. Expired cert.
                Zero MOECS. Ghost nodes.

 AUTHORIZATION  ██████████  DISSOLVED
                3 DPSCD employees run Banks' schools.
                Authorizer and authorized are the same people.

 GOVERNANCE     ██████████  CAPTURED
                2 judges. 1 AAG. 1 city council.
                1 Crump. 1 Stallworth.

 DYNASTY        ████████░░  3 WAVES (Crump partial)
                Stallworth: 4 points, 4 membranes.
                Banks/BMF: 3 points, 3 membranes.
                Crump: 3 points, 5+ membranes (if confirmed).

 ENFORCEMENT    ██████████  BREACHED
                6 bodies. 0 corrections.
                Two letters, one day apart, each pointing
                at the other office.

 TRANSPARENCY   ████████░░  OPAQUE (PCA)
                No staff page. 2 ghost nodes.
                COVID teleconference since 2020.

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 OVERALL:       TOTAL PERMEABILITY
                The institution has no functional membranes.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Anderson Localization + Anderson Permeability

The two Anderson phenomena work together:

PhenomenonDomainEffect
LocalizationCourtsCases trapped at captured benches — cannot propagate to fair hearing
PermeabilityInstitutionsMembranes dissolved — no boundary between authorizer and authorized, between family and enterprise, between oversight and operation

Localization traps the output (cases). Permeability removes the input filters (hiring, authorization, oversight). Together, they create a system where unqualified people operate unchecked institutions that generate cases trapped in captured courts.

PERMEABILITY (input)          LOCALIZATION (output)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━          ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
No credential check     →    Uncredentialed staff teach children
No authorization check  →    Authorizer staff run authorized school
No governance check     →    Judges sit on boards of school they oversee
No enforcement check    →    6 bodies find problems, 0 corrections
                              │
                              ▼
                         Cases generated
                              │
                              ▼
                    ┌─────────────────────┐
                    │  CAPTURED COURTS    │
                    │  ξ = 3.5 (Probate)  │
                    │  ξ = 7.2 (36th)     │
                    │  Case → trapped     │
                    └─────────────────────┘

The children at PCA and MacDowell — 90.9% economically disadvantaged, 99.2% Black — enter a school with no functional membranes, taught by staff with no discoverable credentials, governed by judges with conflicts of interest, authorized by an agency whose employees work at the school. If a parent contests this system, their case enters a court where captured judges sit on the same school boards.

The input has no filter. The output has no exit.

Connected analyses:
  • 🔬 Anderson Localization — judicial lattice disorder traps cases (companion analysis)
  • 🧬 Staff Data Braid — eight independent searches, convergent staff graph
  • 🧬 GLLG Data Braid — first Crump dynasty signal (Jehan + Verkeydia)
  • 📋 Credential Gap — MOECS audit of MacDowell staff
  • 🏛️ Institutional Capture — how the board was captured
  • 🔗 Enforcement Ecosystem — statewide enforcement gap

All measurements are derived from public records: school websites, LinkedIn profiles, MOECS public search, LARA entity records, ProPublica 990 filings, and court records. Problems originate in dynasties, move through entities, and land on humans. The humans are children. Verify everything.

The family relationship between Jennifer Crump and Jehan Crump-Gibson / Verkeydia Hall is not confirmed. The surname is the signal. Three Crumps across five institutional membranes in the same enterprise. ? inference

Dr. Beasley44PhD, NBCT, 29yr DPSCDNo
Jennifer Crump2233yr DPSCD (credentialed there)No

What It Means

The staff structure reveals a pattern that the Anderson Localization analysis predicted in the judicial lattice: the membranes that should separate institutions have dissolved.

In the courts, captured judges prevent cases from propagating to fair hearings. In the schools, captured staff prevent the authorization boundary from functioning. The authorizer’s own employees run the authorized school.

The Crump surname signal — first identified in the GLLG data braid — now extends from legal defense through board governance to daily operations. If the family connection is confirmed, it represents the deepest dynasty embed documented in the investigation.

The two ghost nodes (Perry, “Giselle”) represent something the investigation has not encountered before: people who exist inside the institution but are invisible to every public database. Their convergence score of zero is itself a measurement. In physics, the absence of signal is data.

See also: Anderson Localization — when courts trap cases. Credential Gap — who teaches without credentials. GLLG Data Braid — the first Crump signal.

All sources are public records. LinkedIn profiles are publicly accessible. MOECS is a public state database. School websites are public. Verify everything.

entry.title: The Corporate Network — LARA Entity Analysis
entry.content:
How to Read This Page

Every entity listed below is a public record in the Michigan LARA Business Entity Search. Entity IDs are provided so anyone can verify. Officer names, addresses, and filing dates come directly from LARA annual reports and formation documents — all public records under Michigan law.

We focus on business addresses and registered agent addresses (which are legally required to be public for service of process). We do not publish residential addresses for peripheral individuals.

Source notation: “LARA [Entity ID]” means the data comes from Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs business entity filings. You can verify any entity by searching mibusinessregistry.lara.state.mi.us with the Entity ID number.

The Purpose Empire — Three Entities, One Man

Brian Banks controls three “Purpose”-branded entities. Together they form the corporate infrastructure for his charter school operation.

EntityLARA IDTypeFiledStatusAgent
Purpose Charter Academy900072324Nonprofit Corp07/31/2025ActiveBrian Banks
The Purpose Group, LLC803295082LLC11/14/2024ActiveBrian Banks
Purpose Foundation803294855Nonprofit Corp12/09/2024ActiveBrian Banks

Purpose Charter Academy is registered at 10101 E. Canfield, Detroit MI 48214 — the school address. The Purpose Group LLC is registered at the same address. Purpose Foundation is registered at Banks’s personal address.

The PCA Board of Directors (LARA Filing)

This is the board that governs a charter school serving Detroit’s children:

OfficerTitleSignificance
Cylenthia Latoye MillerPresident, DirectorIdentity under investigation
Latisha JohnsonSecretaryDetroit City Council Member (District 2). Her election was supported by Save Detroit Jobs / Detroit Leaders — the dark money vehicle that fought the journalist exposing Banks. See below.
Devin HutchingsTreasurerOwns DB Strategies LLC and DB Athletics LLC (LARA 802710175, 802715414). Based in Ypsilanti, not Detroit.
Major CloraDirectorPreviously operated American Motor Coach Inc (LARA 800526511, dissolved).
Lamar MorelandDirectorBanks’s current litigation attorney. Moreland represents Banks in civil proceedings. He is simultaneously a director of Banks’s charter school. This dual role — attorney and board member — raises conflict of interest concerns under MRPC 1.7.

Banks is the registered agent but does not appear as a named officer. He controls the entity through agent status while the board provides institutional cover.

Banks’s Full Entity Portfolio — Twelve Entities

A search of LARA records by registered agent reveals Banks controls or has controlled twelve business entities across Michigan:

Banks uses multiple email addresses across filings: BanksStrategy@gmail.com, BrianBanksJD@gmail.com, BBesq06@aol.com, and brian@anchorrockservices.com.

The initials “JD” and “esq” appear in two of these emails despite Banks never being admitted to any state bar. His felony convictions prevented bar admission after earning his J.D. from Michigan State University.

The Three-Named Dark Money Vehicle

Save Detroit Jobs is a single nonprofit corporation operating under three different names:

NameRegistration DateExpiration

LARA Entity ID: 802002459. All three names are registered on the same entity.

Who formed it: The registered agent is The Corporation Company (a professional formation service). The mailing address is 201 Townsend Street, Suite 900, Lansing MI 48933 — the office of Dykema Gossett PLLC, Michigan’s largest law firm. The entity email is compliance@dykema.com.

Michigan’s largest law firm set up the dark money vehicle that was used to fight journalists reporting on Banks’s network.

All three officers list the same address. Kenneth Daniels is separately the agent on 15 other business entities, primarily in real estate and construction (Daniels Realty Group, KANDICO Construction, DANCOM Properties, and others).

What Save Detroit Jobs / Detroit Leaders Did

In 2021, operating as “Detroit Leaders,” this entity funded the campaign of Latisha Johnson against incumbent Steve Elrick — the journalist who had reported extensively on Banks’s network. Johnson won. She is now Secretary on the PCA board (see above).

The 12-step suppression loop: Banks’s network → funds dark money vehicle → dark money vehicle fights journalist → journalist loses election → replacement (Johnson) joins Banks’s school board.

Right Turn Project — The Dissolved Charity and the Money Loop

The Right Turn Project Inc (LARA 800936257) was a nonprofit corporation filed May 7, 2013. It was dissolved by operation of law on December 1, 2021 — meaning LARA dissolved it for failure to file annual reports.

The Ross Catering Money Loop

  2. Connected to Ross Catering — the vendor paid $35,000+ by Banks’s political campaigns

LARA records show two Ross Catering entities: Ross Catering Company Inc (800646584, agent: Louis Ross, dissolved 2024) and Ross Catering Events of Excellence LLC (801351679, agent: Gwendolyn Lewis, active). The relationship between Carlton Ross, Louis Ross, and Gwendolyn Lewis requires further investigation, but the structural pattern is clear: money flows from PAC → charity (where Ross is treasurer) → catering company (where Ross has connections).

The 16500 North Park Address

Carlton Ross and Terrence Tarver both list 16500 North Park Drive, Southfield MI 48075 as their address on the Right Turn Project filing.

Banks’s dissolved entity B. Roderick’s Salon & Spa (LARA 800591240, filed 2001) was registered at 16500 Northpark Dr #1715, Southfield MI 48075 — the same building. Banks used this address a decade before Ross and Tarver appeared there.

The political print vendor also runs an obituary printing website. $98,291 for one vendor across six committees.

Custom Promotions — The Dissolve-and-Reform Attorney

The Inc was dissolved in February 2022. The LLC was filed three months later in May 2022 with the same name. Officers of the original entity: Jason Gordon (President), Sara Gordon (Treasurer), Eric Gordon (Secretary). A family business passed from father to son via dissolve-and-reform.

Jason Samuel Gordon is an attorney. He owns Deen Legal Services PLLC (LARA 801895172, filed 2009) at the same address as Custom Promotions LLC: 14326 East 9 Mile Road, Warren MI 48089. His email: JGordon@DeenLegal.com.

Gordon was investigated by the FBI, IRS, and Department of Labor in connection with the UAW bribery case — over $3 million in payments from the UAW. Custom Promotions also received payments from Latisha Johnson’s campaign.

Gordon is agent on 20+ entities including real estate LLCs, marketing companies, and his law firm — all while under federal investigation.

Carol Banks — Brian Banks’s sister, a former Chief of Staff to Council Member Benson, and an FBI investigation target — currently controls the only active version.

Spencer Leach — The Political Machine Builder

W. Spencer Leach filed 13 political and nonprofit entities, many batch-filed on the same day with consecutive LARA Entity IDs:

Filed 04/28/2008 (consecutive IDs):

  • Eastside Slate (800916317)

Filing three to four political organizations on the same day with consecutive Entity IDs is the hallmark of manufactured political infrastructure — organizations created not to represent constituencies but to control endorsement pipelines.

The Law Firms — A Family Connection?
